Title: Remote Code Execution via OpenSSL 3.x — Heap Buffer Overflow
Threat: An attacker can trigger a heap buffer overflow via a crafted TLS certificate chain enabling arbitrary code execution.
Solution: Upgrade OpenSSL to version 3.0.7 or later.

Title: Privilege Escalation via Kernel Flaw
Threat: A flaw in the Linux kernel's namespace handling allows a local attacker to escalate privileges to root.
Solution: Apply the latest kernel security patch from the vendor.

Title: Authentication Bypass in Apache HTTP Server
Threat: An authentication bypass vulnerability in mod_proxy allows an attacker to bypass access control via a crafted path traversal sequence.
Solution: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to the latest patched release.

Title: OpenSSH Pre-Auth Denial of Service via Malformed Packet Handling
Threat: A remote unauthenticated attacker can crash the sshd process by sending a specially crafted packet during key exchange.
Solution: Upgrade OpenSSH to version 9.9 or later.

Title: PostgreSQL Privilege Escalation via Insecure Extension Loading
Threat: A local database user can load an untrusted shared library extension to execute arbitrary code with superuser privileges.
Solution: Apply the vendor patch and restrict CREATE EXTENSION to trusted roles.

Title: Unsupported Product Detected — CVE-2024-8822
Threat: The installed package version is affected by a known critical remote code execution vulnerability.
Solution: Update to the latest vendor-supported package version.

Title: Missing Security Headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options)
Threat: The web application does not set recommended security headers leaving it more susceptible to clickjacking and XSS.
Solution: Configure the web server to send Content-Security-Policy and X-Frame-Options headers.

Title: Apache Struts Remote Code Execution via OGNL Injection
Threat: A crafted request can trigger OGNL expression evaluation leading to remote code execution.
Solution: Upgrade Apache Struts to the latest patched version.

Title: TLS 1.0/1.1 Protocol Still Enabled
Threat: The server supports deprecated TLS protocol versions vulnerable to downgrade attacks.
Solution: Disable TLS 1.0 and 1.1; enforce TLS 1.2 or higher.

Title: Node.js Prototype Pollution in Dependency Chain
Threat: A crafted JSON payload can pollute Object.prototype leading to denial of service or remote code execution.
Solution: Update the affected npm package to the patched version.

Title: SSL Certificate — Self-Signed Certificate
Threat: The SSL certificate presented by this service is self-signed and not issued by a trusted CA.
Solution: Replace the self-signed certificate with one issued by a trusted internal or public CA.

Title: OpenSSL Denial of Service via Malformed X.509 Certificate
Threat: A malformed X.509 certificate chain can cause excessive CPU consumption leading to denial of service.
Solution: Upgrade OpenSSL to the latest patched release.

Title: Kubernetes API Server Improper Authorization Check

Solution: Review and restrict ClusterRoleBinding assignments; upgrade to the patched Kubernetes release.

Title: SSL/TLS Use of Weak RC4 Cipher
Threat: The remote host supports the use of RC4 in one or more cipher suites which is known to be weak.
Solution: Disable RC4 cipher suites and enforce AES-GCM based suites.
